module_summary: Wishbone bus downsizer: latches each wide request into data/select shift registers, issues per-subword narrow strobes, tags them in a FIFO and reassembles narrow acks into a wide response.

anchors.name: o_sstb
anchors.why: Narrow-bus strobe per subword, from r_stb gated by FIFO full

anchors.name: o_scyc
anchors.why: Narrow-bus cycle, held from wide request until abort or error

anchors.name: o_wstall
anchors.why: Stalls wide bus while subwords remain, FIFO full or narrow stall

anchors.name: o_wack
anchors.why: Wide-bus ack issued after last subword ack or null request

anchors.name: i_wstb
anchors.why: Wide-bus request strobe loading a new transaction

anchors.name: i_sstall
anchors.why: Narrow-bus stall holding the current subword

anchors.name: i_sack
anchors.why: Narrow-bus ack; pops tag FIFO and merges returned data

anchors.name: DOWNSIZE.s_data
anchors.why: Shift register holding wide write data, shifted one subword per issued strobe

anchors.name: DOWNSIZE.s_sel
anchors.why: Shift register of byte selects, decides remaining subwords and o_ssel

anchors.name: o_saddr
anchors.why: Narrow-bus address from r_addr, subaddress advanced per subword

anchors.name: o_sdata
anchors.why: Narrow-bus write data, top subword of s_data

anchors.name: i_wdata
anchors.why: Wide-bus write data latched into s_data

anchors.name: DOWNSIZE.r_first
anchors.why: First-cycle flag: further subwords pending, stalls wide bus and advances address

anchors.name: DOWNSIZE.s_last
anchors.why: Marks last subword; tags FIFO entry for ack and releases stall

anchors.name: DOWNSIZE.s_null
anchors.why: Empty-select request, acknowledged without narrow access

anchors.name: DOWNSIZE.r_shift
anchors.why: Subword shift amount for data, select and address advance

anchors.name: DOWNSIZE.i_subaddr
anchors.why: First active subword index decoded from i_wsel

anchors.name: DOWNSIZE.r_data
anchors.why: Accumulates narrow read data into wide response word driving o_wdata

anchors.name: DOWNSIZE.nxt_data
anchors.why: Merges i_sdata into r_data at subword position from fifo_addr

anchors.name: DOWNSIZE.fifo_addr
anchors.why: Subword position of returning ack popped from tag FIFO

anchors.name: DOWNSIZE.fifo_ack
anchors.why: Last-subword tag from FIFO, generates wide ack

anchors.name: DOWNSIZE.fifo_full
anchors.why: Tag FIFO full, blocks narrow strobes and stalls wide bus

anchors.name: DOWNSIZE.fifo_empty
anchors.why: No outstanding narrow requests; selects null ack path

anchors.name: o_werr
anchors.why: Wide-bus error from registered narrow error, aborts cycle

anchors.name: i_sdata
anchors.why: Narrow-bus read data merged into response

groups.name: request_serializer
groups.description: Splits wide request into narrow subword strobes via data/select shift registers

groups.name: ack_tag_fifo
groups.description: FIFO tagging outstanding narrow requests with subword position and last flag

groups.name: response_assembler
groups.description: Reassembles narrow read data into wide word and generates wide ack/err
